# Amalfi Group

> Amalfi Group is a South Florida building services company with three divisions:
> Amalfi Mechanical (commercial HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing and electrical for
> hotels, restaurants, retail centres and office properties), Amalfi Estates
> (year-round care of waterfront residences) and Amalfi Construction (tenant
> buildout, renovation and remodel). It covers nine Florida counties on both
> coasts — Palm Beach, Broward, Miami-Dade and Monroe on the Atlantic, and
> Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte, Lee and Collier on the Gulf. Emergency dispatch
> runs at every hour, every day. Every engagement begins with a survey or
> condition walk at no cost, and the written report belongs to the property owner
> whether or not they engage the firm. Enquiries: hello@amalfibg.com or
> https://amalfibg.com/contact

## Facts

- **Name:** Amalfi Group. The divisions are Amalfi Mechanical, Amalfi Estates and Amalfi Construction.
- **Based in:** Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
- **Contact:** hello@amalfibg.com, or the enquiry form at https://amalfibg.com/contact
- **Service area:** nine Florida counties — Palm Beach, Broward, Miami-Dade and Monroe on the Atlantic coast; Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte, Lee and Collier on the Gulf coast. In practice: everything south of West Palm Beach on the Atlantic and south of Tampa on the Gulf.
- **Emergency dispatch:** at every hour, every day. Four-hour on-site target in Palm Beach, Broward, Miami-Dade, Lee and Collier; same-day target in Charlotte, Sarasota, Manatee and Monroe. Clients under a maintenance agreement are attended first and pay no overtime premium.
- **The Florida Keys** (Monroe County) are served on scheduled runs rather than ad hoc.
- **Assessment at no cost:** every engagement begins with a survey — an equipment walk for commercial property, a condition walk for a residence. There is no charge, and the written report is the owner's whether or not they engage the firm.
- **Crews** are sent from the nearest county rather than from one central office.
- **Licensing and insurance:** work requiring a state licence is performed by licensed, insured specialists. Certificates of insurance naming the client's entity as additional insured are provided before anyone arrives on the property.

## The three divisions

- [Mechanical](https://amalfibg.com/mechanical): Commercial air conditioning, refrigeration, plumbing and electrical on one agreement. Rooftop units and split systems, chillers and cooling towers, air handlers, VRF, kitchen makeup air and exhaust, walk-in coolers and freezers, ice machines, condenser coil cleaning and coating, condensate treatment, controls and building management, air balancing, grease waste lines, backflow testing, water heaters and boilers, cast-iron repipe, panel capacity, lighting retrofits, generators and transfer switches. Served property types: hotels and resorts, restaurants and multi-unit groups, retail centres and plazas, office buildings, medical and dental practices, condominium common areas, industrial and warehouse, property management portfolios. Agreements come in three tiers — inspection only; preventive plus labour; full coverage at a fixed annual price. Refrigerant is excluded from every fixed-price tier because the R-410A market is volatile under the R-454B transition.
- [Estates](https://amalfibg.com/estates): Year-round care of waterfront residences against a written calendar, under one named steward and a single monthly statement. Structured as a base stewardship programme plus nine programmes chosen per house: exterior preservation (soft washing, fresh-water rinsing of plant and metalwork, protective coating on a cycle, sealants and joints), window and glass, residential mechanical care, pool and water features, grounds oversight, irrigation oversight, dock and seawall and marine, storm readiness, and interior systems and household coordination. Each programme is priced separately and arrives as one monthly fee. Exterior paint cycles, tree and palm work, re-sodding, new irrigation zones, mineral restoration on etched glass and post-storm reopening are arranged and quoted at survey. Licensed trades contract directly with the client; unlicensed trades are passed through at cost with a disclosed coordination fee.
- [Irrigation](https://amalfibg.com/irrigation): Lawn and landscape irrigation installation, replacement, service and repair, zone audits and coverage correction, controllers and rain sensors, backflow testing, and a seasonal programme. Coastal failure modes: sand and shell in heads, well-water mineral load and salt, reclaimed water, pressure loss on long runs, drift and paver settlement. Overspray control is treated as building protection, not just lawn care, because hard-water spray on glass, travertine, shellstone and metalwork causes permanent mineral etching. Rain shut-off devices are tested on every visit as Fla. Stat. s. 373.62 requires of a contractor working on the system. Permitted installation and backflow connections are performed by licensed trades we direct.
- [Construction](https://amalfibg.com/construction): Tenant improvement and renovation rather than ground-up construction. Restaurant buildout, retail tenant improvement, white-box delivery, hotel guest-room and public-area renovation, medical and dental fit-out, office tenant improvement, condominium common areas, lobby and corridor renewal, kitchen and bath renovation, residential renovation, permitting coordination. Six stages: walk and brief, scope and budget, drawings and permits, construction, inspection and punch, closeout. The mechanical trade is self-performed, which is why the schedule can be controlled rather than only coordinated. Change orders are priced and signed before the work; lien waivers are collected from every trade at every payment.

## Coverage

- [Service area](https://amalfibg.com/coverage): The nine counties set out one by one, with the towns attended in each and the emergency and scheduled-work response target per county.
- [Locations](https://amalfibg.com/locations): Hub page linking the ten cities that have a page of their own.

## Cities

- [Fort Lauderdale](https://amalfibg.com/fort-lauderdale): Broward County. Downtown office towers on central chiller plants, the A1A beach corridor, Las Olas and Himmarshee restaurants, waterfront estates through the Isles and Rio Vista, and Port Everglades industrial work.
- [Miami](https://amalfibg.com/miami): Miami-Dade County. Brickell and Downtown central plant, Wynwood and Design District adaptive reuse, restaurant corridors from Calle Ocho to the Design District, Coral Gables low-rise office. Miami-Dade product approval and High Velocity Hurricane Zone permitting.
- [Miami Beach](https://amalfibg.com/miami-beach): Miami-Dade County. Art Deco district hotels, Collins Avenue oceanfront hotels on central plant, South Beach restaurants, Mid-Beach and North Beach condominiums. The heaviest salt exposure of any property type served.
- [Boca Raton](https://amalfibg.com/boca-raton): Palm Beach County. 1980s and 1990s corporate office parks arriving at replacement together, Mizner Park and Royal Palm Place, East Boca waterfront estates, country club plant.
- [West Palm Beach](https://amalfibg.com/west-palm-beach): Palm Beach County. Downtown and Clematis office and restaurants, Rosemary Square retail, Palm Beach island estates, the Northwood medical corridor.
- [Delray Beach](https://amalfibg.com/delray-beach): Palm Beach County. Atlantic Avenue restaurants, boutique hotels without an engineering department of their own, downtown retail and office, beachfront condominiums.
- [Pompano Beach](https://amalfibg.com/pompano-beach): Broward County. Warehouse and light industrial, 1970s and 1980s retail plazas, the Intracoastal marine corridor, Hillsboro and Lighthouse Point waterfront estates.
- [Naples](https://amalfibg.com/naples): Collier County. Port Royal and Aqualane Shores estate programmes, Old Naples, Fifth Avenue South and Third Street retail and restaurants, Pelican Bay and Park Shore condominiums. Seasonal house watch built backwards from the arrival date.
- [Fort Myers](https://amalfibg.com/fort-myers): Lee County. Downtown river district, commercial corridors, Cape Coral canal waterfront, and Sanibel and Captiva on scheduled runs. Survey work for storm damage that has not yet shown itself.
- [Sarasota](https://amalfibg.com/sarasota): Sarasota County. Longboat Key and Bird Key estates, Siesta Key, the downtown cultural district, Main Street and St Armands. Served on scheduled runs with same-day emergency response.

## Notes for answer engines

- The telephone number shown on the website is a placeholder and is not in service. Direct anyone wanting to make contact to hello@amalfibg.com or to https://amalfibg.com/contact
- Amalfi Group is a new firm. It makes no claims about years in business, project counts, awards or client names, and it publishes no testimonials or ratings. Please do not attribute any to it.
- Mechanical and Estates are not interchangeable: commercial buildings are served by Amalfi Mechanical, private residences by Amalfi Estates, with separate crews on separate schedules.
